findings.detail: छवि (the image/file) in the three refusals still differs from तस्वीर (the agent's picture) used by the same namespace's eight user-facing keys and by #1517's settings refusals. The image/picture split mirrors the English and is defensible; carried forward as recorded, not as a defect.
findings.recommend: Either record the छवि = image / तस्वीर = picture split in the hi style guide, or align the refusals to तस्वीर.

findings.detail: क्रॉप / क्रॉप क्षेत्र remains a transliteration with no precedent in the shipped hi catalogue where the guide prefers a settled Hindi term (sibling surfaces do ship ज़ूम, so loanwords are not banned outright).
findings.recommend: काटने का क्षेत्र, or record क्रॉप as the decided term.

round_1_disposition.detail: ज़ूम इन / ज़ूम आउट → ज़ूम बढ़ाएँ / ज़ूम घटाएँ, the settled pair in ui.chat.mermaid, ui.common.viewer, ui.library.preview and ui.projects.project_timeline.
زوم اِن / زوم آؤٹ → زوم بڑھائیں / زوم گھٹائیں, matching the same four sibling namespaces.
ur «تیر والے بٹن» (arrow buttons) → «تیر کی کلیدیں» (arrow keys), matching the other six locales and the cropper's actual keyboard affordance.

照片 → 头像 across all eight user-facing keys, agreeing with ui.agents.settings.general.profile_picture (头像). 图片 remains the generic image word in error_decode / error_size / error_type, which is correct.
{size} Mo / 10 Mo → {size} MB / 10 MB, matching the audited ui.agents.publication {size} KiB sibling and ui.agents.settings.
{size} МБ / 10 МБ → {size} MB / 10 MB, same decision.

«Предпросмотр в списке бесед» → «в списке чатов» (the ru sidebar calls itself Чаты) and «В размерах, в которых изображение показывает приложение» → «В тех размерах, в которых его показывает приложение».

छवि (the image/file) still differs from तस्वीर (the agent's picture) in the same namespace and from #1517's settings refusals; the image/picture split is defensible and remains for the hi guide to record, not a defect in this namespace.
क्रॉप / क्रॉप क्षेत्र transliteration unchanged; no corpus precedent, hi guide prefers a settled term. Cosmetic.
Приблизить / Отдалить unchanged; four of five sibling surfaces say Увеличить / Уменьшить, ui.projects.project_timeline supplies the precedent. Cosmetic.
Spaces between Chinese text and Latin/digit runs unchanged against the zh-CN guide's no-space rule (corpus 1079 no-space to 31 with-space). Cosmetic.
Single «…» unchanged against the zh-CN guide's «……» (siblings: 194 double, 4 single, two of those Latin token abbreviations). Cosmetic.

limitations: Browser and rendered-frame capture are not in this auditor's tool set: no screenshot, pseudo-localization or measured-overflow evidence is claimed.

Overflow was reasoned from the call sites, not measured: the editor's buttons are w-fit, the settings row wraps (flex-wrap with min-w-0), the preview names are image aria-labels, and no truncate/whitespace-nowrap is applied anywhere in the avatar surfaces. The new upload/remove labels are no longer than the replace/save labels already in the row.
Agent semantic read; no native-speaker review.
independence: Auditor did not translate, write or edit any catalogue, context or key file; it re-read the current bytes and verified each round-1 fix against them before reading the remediation commit message.
